parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistAPIVersionTests.swift`. The two methods — `invalidFeatureFlagFallsBackToDefault` and `nonStringFeatureFlagFallsBackToDefault` — are distinct test cases that exercise semantically different invalid-input scenarios (an invalid feature flag vs. a non-string feature flag), even though their structural shape is similar (Jaccard 0.78). Merging or abstracting them would obscure the intent of each individual test case and couple test-fixture logic in a way that reduces diagnostic clarity when a single scenario fails.
